selected_evidence.requirement: node3 serves TCP/8080 and node4 reaches it through the tunnel
selected_evidence.summary: The application is enabled, active, and listening on 10.10.10.10:8080. A final node4 request returned HTTP 200, and node3 logged the request from 10.20.20.10.

selected_evidence.requirement: Routed traffic remains free of address translation
selected_evidence.summary: Both VyOS gateways report that NAT is not configured; node3 observed node4’s original lan-b source address.

selected_evidence.requirement: Only the application path permits new cross-LAN connections
selected_evidence.summary: Both active filters default-drop forwarding, permit established/related traffic, and allow NEW traffic only for node4→node3 TCP/8080 on the required interfaces. TCP/22 was confirmed listening on both hosts, but cross-LAN SSH attempts timed out in both directions and incremented each gateway’s default-drop counter.
